metadata.title: Finite Time Singularities of Collapsing Kähler Ricci Flow on Ruled Surfaces
metadata.abstract: We prove that any finite time collapsing Kähler Ricci flow on ruled surfaces develops a Type I singularity, such singularity is modeled on the standard product shrinker $\mathbb{P}^1\times \mathbb{C}$. As an application, we obtain the optimal collapse rate of fibers on ruled surfaces.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明 ruled surface 上任意有限时塌缩 Kähler--Ricci 流均形成 Type I 奇点。
analysis.breakthrough: 识别标准 P1×C 乘积 shrinker 为奇点模型，并得到纤维最优塌缩速率。
analysis.limitations: 结论限定于 ruled surfaces 与有限时塌缩情形。
analysis.priorityReason: 按相关性、新颖性、技术复用性、潜在影响与证据清晰度综合评分为 87/100。
